decisions.notes: European robin with orange-red face and breast, olive-brown back and wings, standing on thin pink legs. Hyper-detailed Grab3D animal: glTF validation clean (0 errors), single fused mesh at ~800k triangles with three PBR texture maps (basecolor, normal, roughness/metallic). Upstream lists it as a realistic (non-cartoon) high-detail model. Unrigged static mesh.
limitations: AI-assisted origin is disclosed upstream (origin.ai_content); some storefronts require an AI-content disclosure when you resell.
Unrigged: the walking/standing pose is baked into the mesh, so it cannot be re-posed or animated without adding a skeleton.
Single fused mesh with baked textures; no separate parts to animate.

decisions.notes: Faceted low poly crab in red and orange with raised claws and eight spread legs. Intentional low-poly style: glTF validation clean (0 errors), faceted flat-shaded mesh at ~3k triangles with a single texture. Grab3D ships these as 'Lightweight' companions to the high-detail animals. Scoring reflects the deliberate low-poly aesthetic: clean silhouette and complete animal, but flat-shaded materials and minimal topology rather than PBR.
limitations: AI-assisted origin is disclosed upstream (origin.ai_content); some storefronts require an AI-content disclosure when you resell.
Deliberately low-detail (~3k triangles, flat-shaded, single texture) for mobile/stylised use; not PBR.
Unrigged static mesh with baked pose.
